avoid_supplements.name: Psyllium husk
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Combined osmotic and bulk-forming laxative effects may cause excessive fluid loss, severe diarrhea, and electrolyte imbalances
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; space administration by at least 2-4 hours if both are necessary

avoid_supplements.name: Senna
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive laxative effects leading to excessive bowel stimulation, dehydration, and electrolyte depletion
avoid_supplements.action: Do not combine; use only one laxative agent at a time under medical supervision

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: PEG may reduce absorption of some minerals through osmotic effects and rapid GI transit; minimal clinical impact with standard dosing
caution_supplements.action: Monitor serum calcium levels if high-dose or prolonged PEG use; separate administration by 2+ hours when possible

caution_foods.name: High-fiber foods (beans, whole grains, vegetables)
caution_foods.mechanism: Combined fiber and osmotic effect may intensify bowel movements and cause abdominal discomfort
caution_foods.action: Patient may temporarily reduce fiber intake during active PEG bowel cleansing; resume normal diet after treatment completion

monitoring_notes: PEG is not metabolized and has minimal systemic absorption; primary concern is electrolyte balance and hydration status during use. Monitor for signs of dehydration and advise adequate fluid intake throughout therapy.
